flags.summary: Vasile and Petre told the party that Widow Ileana leaves her shutter open a crack every night (The Polite Caller).
Old Mihail told the party he dug a grave for Teodor the cooper three winters ago and nobody ever filled it.
The party is sitting up with Ileana at her cottage by the churchyard gate; Teodor comes after dark.
The party has spoken with Teodor at Ileana's shutter.
Insight showed that Teodor has fed on nothing that talks in a long time; he lives on wolves.
Teodor told the party he is why the dead never scratch at Ileana's door.
The master's coachman and his dead came for Ileana's door and were beaten (encounter teodor_errand).
What became of Teodor: dawn (he watched the sunrise with Ileana), woods (he went into the trees) or ended (the party destroyed him).
The dawn after the vigil has been played; The Polite Caller is over.
Teodor told the party he filled his own empty grave with what he couldn't give back; the churchyard cache can be opened.
Vasile and Petre (or Bildrath) told the party that Grigore's son Luca came home late with a load of wood and hasn't woken since (Cut After Noon).
The party worked out that the late wood is blight seedwood and that it wants Luca back.
Bildrath handed over the load of late wood he bought from Grigore.
The party burned the late wood by day and finished what crawled out (encounter woodpile_burns).
At dusk the late wood stood up in Grigore's yard as one thing, and the party cut it down (encounter woodpile_wakes).
The splinter is out of Luca's hand and he is awake.
Grigore has offered the party his forty gold for Luca (taken or refused).
Bildrath paid the party to forget he sold walking firewood (the Wraps of Unarmed Power, and his discount).
Zora told the party the black carriage stopped by Radu's pen and that he walked his grey mare to the crossroads (The Grey Mare).
Radu admitted he sold Steaua because the voice in the carriage promised Nicu would ride home.
The party told Radu that Nicu hangs at the crossroads, so the castle's promise was a lie.
Steaua, tied at the crossroads milestone, has been calmed enough to touch.
The one Animal Handling try to calm Steaua failed (and the brand took her).
The one Religion try at Steaua's brand failed (and the brand took her).
The castle's brand on Steaua was broken and she ran home grey.
Steaua was finished into one of the castle's black horses; she fights for the carriage.
The black carriage came to the crossroads for Steaua (its props show until the fight is won).
The black carriage's escort was beaten at the crossroads (encounter carriage_escort).
Who keeps Steaua after she comes home: radu or luminita.
Radu has paid the party and The Grey Mare is over.
The Vallaki watch or Lady Wachter told the party about the girl in the window at Wachterhaus (The Cat in the Window).
The party has been into Stella Wachter's locked bedroom and seen her.
The party found the ribbon and the bell, and heard Stella's promise: she isn't mad, she's held.
Somebody cut Stella's ribbon without breaking the curse; the bell rang, and the ribbon tied itself again.
When the curse broke, what came out of Stella's shadow was beaten (encounter stella_shadow).
Stella has gone to Father Lucian at St. Andral's.
Stella gave the party her dowry and the master's cloak at St. Andral's.
Stella told the party how to open the panel behind the study bookcase at Wachterhaus.
Father Lucian gave the party the church's last Scroll of Remove Curse for Stella.
Urwin told the party about the black roses on the chandler's step (Black Roses).
The party saw the bite marks under Ilie's scarf: Ana feeds on her father.
The party agreed to watch the Petrovs' house after dark.
Ana came to Mila's window and spoke with the party.
The party knows Ana sleeps in her own grave in St. Andral's churchyard (the grave prop shows).
Ana and the two other girls are destroyed (encounters roses_street or roses_graves).
Ilie gave the party Ana's mother's ring; Black Roses is over.
lost: the party let Ana go home and she fed on Ilie until he died.
Pyotr Petrov paid the party for his daughter's life.
The Krezk watchman or Kasha told the party about the carved toys on the Krezkov graves (Lighter Than It Should Be).
The party waited at the Krezkov graves after midnight.
Sorin came over the pool's north wall with a toy and saw the party.
The party knows the toy-bringer is Sorin Krezkov, the Krezkovs' first son, taken up the mountain twenty years ago.
The party dug up the eldest Krezkov's grave: a coffin of stones wrapped in a blanket.
The abbey's Brutes and the brides before Vasilka were beaten at the pool (encounter sorin_pursuers).
Sorin followed the party to the Krezkovs' house.
Where Sorin lives now: home (with the Krezkovs), pool (with Kasha) or mountain (back to the abbey).
Arik told the party that Old Mihail digs his graves early (Six Feet).
Goodwife Petra told the party about Zinaida, the bride who went down the well rather than marry the castle's man.
The party brought Zinaida's bones up from the bottom of the village well.
Zinaida was talked down when she rose (her name, or Persuasion), and waits at the grave.
Zinaida rose screaming and was beaten at the well (encounter well_bride).
Zinaida is buried in the grave Mihail dug for his sister; Six Feet is over.
Zora told the party Big Tobar's son followed his dead mother's voice toward the falls (Called by Name).
At Tser Falls the voices drew someone toward the gorge's edge before the fight (the party starts it surprised).
The will-o'-wisps in the gorge under Tser Falls were put out (encounter falls_wisps).
The party brought Nelu up from his ledge in the gorge.
Nelu is back at the Tser Pool camp and Tobar has paid the party.
Daciana or Anton let slip that someone reads the lists of who won't wear a festival ribbon (Ribbons).
The party took one of Daciana's ribbons.
Daciana told the party she leaves her list under the lamp on Main Street at dusk.
Daciana agreed to leave tonight's list blank.
The party knows Dobre sells each list three times: the Baron, Wachterhaus and the castle's rider.
Watchman Dobre and his lads were beaten (encounters ribbons_street or ribbons_gate).
The lists were dealt with and Ribbons is over.
What became of the lists: town (Lucian and Urwin), baron (the Baron) or burned.
Urwin told the party about Szoldar and Yevgeni, the hunters in the corner (The Hunters at the Inn).
Yevgeni told the party that Arrigal pays his father to bring strong strangers to Old Greytooth.
Szoldar agreed to shoot the wolf, not the party.
Szoldar stayed at the inn instead of going to the hunt.
Szoldar fled the fight at the lake when he was hurt (withdraw in greytooth_hunt).
Old Greytooth and his pack were killed at the Lake Zarovich landing (encounter greytooth_hunt).
Yevgeni paid the party the Baron's bounty and gave them the horn.
The party stood between the drowned of Pescari and the man they came for (The Bell Under the Lake).
The party stood aside and let the drowned take Bluto into the lake.
The drowned of Pescari were driven back under the water (encounter drowned_landing).
The bell under Lake Zarovich was cut loose or rung for the dead; the quest is over.
Zora or Vasile and Petre told the party about the riders who go east to the gates every night (The Last Muster).
The party has met the Last Muster at the Gates of Barovia.
The party convinced the vanguard's riders that their war is over; only the marshal and his lieutenants fight.
Marshal Dragomir was beaten at the gate (encounter bone_marshal).
The party took the Marshal's blade and the vanguard's pay chest.
Stelian the goatherd told the party the one-horned billy turned up with a ring on his horn (The One-Horned Billy).
The party read the ring on the billy's horn: D. AND V. BEREZ.
The party saw the man behind the billy's eyes (Insight, or Speak with Animals).
The curse is off the billy: he's Dragos, the ferryman of Berez.
The Rag Queen was burned in Berez's scarecrow field (encounter rag_queen).
Dragos gave the party the brides' dowries and the dancing sword.
Pidlwick II agreed to meet Blinsky the toymaker and travels with the party to Vallaki (The Toymaker's Masterpiece).
Pidlwick II met Blinsky in his shop; the scene at the bottom of Blinsky's stair has played (The Toymaker's Masterpiece).
The party told Blinsky what Pidlwick II did to the first Pidlwick; Blinsky is building a ramp (The Toymaker's Masterpiece).
Pidlwick II left the party to live at Blinsky Toys; he's in the shop, not on the castle stair (The Toymaker's Masterpiece).
The party has seen Pidlwick II juggling in Blinsky's window once (The Toymaker's Masterpiece).
Dmitri refused, so Clovin comes down to Krezk's show in a monk's hood (Clovin's Audience).
How well Clovin's show in Krezk is going: one for each beat that lands (the warm-up, the advice, the heckler) (Clovin's Audience).
The party has tried to read the Krezk crowd at Clovin's show (Clovin's Audience).
Old Pavel the carver turned out to be Clovin's great-uncle, after Clovin's show in Krezk (Clovin's Audience).
The party has met Mouse, the girl selling plain pastries on the miller's lane (The Fourth Sister).
The party has seen the iron coming in at Mouse's gums and nails (The Fourth Sister).
Goodwife Sarnov told the party about her first baby, Zamfira, and the mark on her wrist (The Fourth Sister).
The party told Mouse her name, Zamfira (The Fourth Sister).
The party tried to call Mouse away from Granny Ash on her birthday night (The Fourth Sister).
Unnamed, Mouse chose the party over Granny Ash on her birthday night (The Fourth Sister).
Where Mouse ended up: home (Zamfira, with the Sarnovs), keepers (with Ilinca Vrana) or given (to Granny Ash) (The Fourth Sister).
The party has met Goodwife Sarnov on her step in the village (The Fourth Sister).
The party told Goodwife Sarnov that the girl on the lane is her daughter (The Fourth Sister).
Granny Ash, Morgantha's mother, is dead in the miller's lane (The Fourth Sister).
The party saw that the Seventh Row's vines are all one blight grown up into the rootstock (The Black Row).
The party found raven feathers and a man's bare footprints in the Seventh Row (The Black Row).
Adrian agreed to help pull up the Seventh Row and fought the Vine Mother beside the party (The Black Row).
The Vine Mother, the Gulthias cutting under the Seventh Row, is dead (The Black Row).
Davian paid the party for cutting out the Seventh Row (The Black Row).
Whose scent the count's huntsman has: party (Strahd has marked them) or gavril (the Vistani groom) (The Count's Huntsman).
The party read the names on the quarry stones by the crossroads (The Count's Huntsman).
The party called the Huntsman's hounds by their names, and some of them lay down (The Count's Huntsman).
The party has looked at the Huntsman closely, at the crossroads (The Count's Huntsman).
The Huntsman told the party who he was: Toader, the count's first quarry (The Count's Huntsman).
The count's Huntsman and his hounds are down at the crossroads (The Count's Huntsman).
The party took the Huntsman's saddlebag and the hounds walked free (The Count's Huntsman).
The party has met Mother, the Belviews' matriarch, in the wards kitchen (Mother's Ninth Improvement).
Mother knows her boys in the cells have been let out or are dead (Mother's Ninth Improvement).
The party took the silver wire out of Mother's wings (Mother's Ninth Improvement).
Mother flew down the mountain to Krezk (Mother's Ninth Improvement).
The party met Cosmin on the squires' graves at Argynvostholt (The Squire).
The party read Ioan's words on the back of the last squire's headstone (The Squire).
Sir Godfrey remembered sending Ioan with the dragon's last words; Ioan didn't flee (The Squire).
The party stood the squire's vigil with Cosmin against the men-at-arms (The Squire).
The party found the nine pilgrims frozen in the gorge wall at the Tsolenka landing (The Frozen Pilgrims).
The party tried to work out what holds the frozen pilgrims (The Frozen Pilgrims).
Mother Ecaterina spoke to the party through the ice (The Frozen Pilgrims).
The Penitent, the eight pilgrims fused in ice, is meltwater at the Tsolenka landing (The Frozen Pilgrims).
Lupu, the burgomaster's wolfhound, let the party come close and led them to the study wall (The Burgomaster's Hound).
The party found Kolyan's note in the bricks: his first son Sergiu is walled up behind the study (The Burgomaster's Hound).
The Tenant behind the study wall, and the servants who starved with him, are dead (The Burgomaster's Hound).
The party met Iosif the Tinker at his wagon by the crossroads (The Tinker's Wagon).
The party watched Iosif closely while he sold (The Tinker's Wagon).
The party looked closely at Iosif's wagon (The Tinker's Wagon).
The Tinker's Wagon, a mimic the size of a wagon, is dead at the crossroads (The Tinker's Wagon).
The party looked at the dead pine's branches above the raven cage (The Ravens' Ransom).
The party crept in and opened the cage before the fowlers moved (The Ravens' Ransom).
The count's fowlers heard the party coming, or saw them walk up to the cage (The Ravens' Ransom).
The count's fowlers on the hill trail are dead (The Ravens' Ransom).
The party looked closely at Bray after the cage (The Ravens' Ransom).
Bray went home with the fowlers' charm still in him; something listens through him (The Ravens' Ransom).
The fowlers' charm on Bray is broken (The Ravens' Ransom).
The party met Petru in Krezk's goat pens (The Pack's Runt).
The party looked closely at Petru and saw the wolf in him (The Pack's Runt).
The party lifted the curse of lycanthropy from Petru (The Pack's Runt).
The Grandsire, the werewolf pack's eldest, is dead in Krezk's square (The Pack's Runt).
The party found Corvina's first letter in the frost garden on Mount Baratok (The Mage's Lost Pages).
The party found Corvina's letter with her name in the ring of glass (The Mage's Lost Pages).
The party found Corvina's last letter, with the count's postscript, at the overlook (The Mage's Lost Pages).
Mordenkainen read the letters and gave the party his apprentice's name, Corvina, to say to her in the castle (The Mage's Lost Pages).
The party said Corvina's name at the unnamed crypt before she rose (The Unnamed Crypt).
Corvina, the Doorkeeper, is at rest in the castle's catacombs (The Unnamed Crypt).
The party met Ilarion at the edge of the mists on the Old Svalich Road (The Last Traveller).
The party looked properly at Ilarion's rags (The Last Traveller).
The count's wolves that came out of the fog for Ilarion are dead (The Last Traveller).
Ilarion is home in the village with his children, Petra and Mihail (The Last Traveller).
The count's keepers at the gate on the north shoulder of Ghakis are destroyed (The Warm Snow).
Doina and Petrache, the count's tithe, are freed from the cart on Ghakis (The Warm Snow).
The party read the keepers' log under Ghakis: Sarkhaza's name, the salt, the drum and the sluice (The Warm Snow).
The party salted a carcass in the Ghakis larder well enough that a dragon won't taste it (The Warm Snow).
The party salted a carcass in the Ghakis larder, badly (The Warm Snow).
The party hauled Sarkhaza's chain in on the great drum: she starts the fight choking (The Warm Snow).
Sarkhaza tore her chain back out of the party's hands at the drum (The Warm Snow).
The Vent-Fire and the burnt keepers in the vent gallery under Ghakis are destroyed (The Warm Snow).
The party opened the sluice under Ghakis and drowned the vents: her lair can't act in the fight (The Warm Snow).
The party saw that Sarkhaza's hoard is gilt lead (The Warm Snow).
The party looked at Sarkhaza's hoard from a distance and saw only gold (The Warm Snow).
Sarkhaza, the red dragon under Ghakis, is dead (The Warm Snow).
The party has spoken with Sarkhaza (The Warm Snow).
Sarkhaza told the party how she came through the mists and offered to burn the count out (The Warm Snow).
The party tried to read Sarkhaza while she talked about the castle (The Warm Snow).
The party saw through Sarkhaza: she can't fly, and wants the villages, not the count (The Warm Snow).
Sarkhaza ate the party's salted carcass: she fights slowed, with fewer Hit Points (The Warm Snow).
Sarkhaza smelled the salt in the party's carcass and burned it (The Warm Snow).
The party pulled the pin from Sarkhaza's collar (The Warm Snow).
The hearthstone in Van Richten's Tower is up and the stair to Khazan's undercroft is open (The Name Over the Door).
The party read Khazan's book of names and found their own (The Name Over the Door).
The party has spoken with Khazan in his study (The Name Over the Door).
Khazan told the party who he is (The Name Over the Door).
The party knows Khazan's phylactery is his name over the tower door (The Name Over the Door).
The party tried to work out what holds Khazan in the world, and couldn't (The Name Over the Door).
The Remembered in Khazan's hall of names are laid to rest (The Name Over the Door).
Khazan was driven out of his body and went back into his name over the door (The Name Over the Door).
The party unmade the name over the tower door: Khazan's next body is his last (The Name Over the Door).
The party has seen Khazan without his name (The Name Over the Door).
The party said Khazan's name to him once more before the end: he starts the last fight unready (The Name Over the Door).
Khazan is destroyed for good (The Name Over the Door).
The slab over the weeping crack in the Amber Temple's vault is up, and the stair under it is open (The Amber Debt).
The party read in the wardens' book why they turned the hall's mirrors on the Eye Below (The Amber Debt).
The party has the wardens' lullaby from their book (The Amber Debt).
The party turned the hall's mirrors toward the Eye's chamber: its dreamed eyes fight the glass, and its lair can't act (The Amber Debt).
The party sang the wardens' lullaby to the Eye Below, well or badly (The Amber Debt).
The party sang the Eye Below half back into its amber: it starts the fight surprised and hurt (The Amber Debt).
The dreamed eyes and the sleeper in the hall of sleepers are destroyed (The Amber Debt).
The party has spoken with the Eye Below (The Amber Debt).
The Eye Below is dead (The Amber Debt).
The party told Exethanter the thing he sealed is dead (The Amber Debt).
Mordenkainen has thanked the party for finding Corvina (The Unnamed Crypt); his next news is Khazan (The Name Over the Door).
The party found Kostin planting his clean tree on the burned crown of Yester Hill (The Druid Who Came Back).
The party met Zorica planting her cutting on the crown of Yester Hill (The Druid Who Came Back).
The party tried to talk Zorica down from her planting, or she chose to fight (The Druid Who Came Back).
Zorica put her spade down: she doesn't fight beside the Ash Effigy (The Druid Who Came Back).
The Ash Effigy on the crown of Yester Hill is destroyed (The Druid Who Came Back).
Veta the nursemaid told the party her name and where her bones are (The Nursemaid's Grave).
The party took Veta's bones from the attic trunk to carry them down to Walter (The Nursemaid's Grave).
The house's keepers who came for Veta in Walter's crypt are put down (The Nursemaid's Grave).
Old Sabin told the party about the extra lantern and Sandu (One Lantern Too Many).
Old Sabin remembered who the extra lantern is for: his daughter Liliana (One Lantern Too Many).
The party has met the Lantern Girl at the end of the fishers' jetty (One Lantern Too Many).
The party told the Lantern Girl her father remembers (One Lantern Too Many).
The party brought up the Lantern Girl's lantern and she went out of her own accord (One Lantern Too Many).
The Lantern Girl was put out in a fight on the fishers' jetty (One Lantern Too Many).
Parriwimple showed the party the north path to the hollow where Agafia hides (The Oat Thief).
The party met Agafia at the charcoal-burners' hollow (The Oat Thief).
The party saw the hunters' trail of spilled oats: the pack's hunters are caught unawares (The Oat Thief).
The pack's hunters who followed the oats to Agafia's door are beaten (The Oat Thief).
Agafia thanked the party with her grandmother's speaking stones (The Oat Thief).
The party met Tibor the egg-hunter at the Tsolenka landing (The Last Egg).
The party saw the count's marks on Tibor's wrist: the buyer is the castle (The Last Egg).
The party took the hatching roc egg from the nest (The Last Egg).
The party let the count's falconer take the roc's chick (The Last Egg).
The count's falconer and his stone birds are beaten on the roc's shelf (The Last Egg).
Haralamb told the party about his eleven nights at the castle (The Count's Portraitist).
The party saw that Haralamb's paint makes eyes of the castle (The Count's Portraitist).
Haralamb let the party into his studio on the east row (The Count's Portraitist).
The count's great canvas in Haralamb's studio is burned, and every copy in Vallaki is blank (The Count's Portraitist).
Escher's Petition: Insight on Escher showed the rest of the count's answer, Bring your friends; Querreth doesn't catch the party unawares on the roof.
Escher's Petition: Escher watched the sun come up from the south tower roof and burned in it. He's gone from his suite.
Escher's Petition: the party talked Escher into waiting for a dawn the count isn't in; he's back in his suite.
The Silver Hoard: Sir Godfrey told the party about the Dragon's Tithe, or they found the draught under the servants' table; the undercroft stair opens.
The Silver Hoard: the party met the tithe-keeper on his chest in the undercroft.
The Silver Hoard: the party said the dragon's last words to the tithe-keeper (Let them go home); he wants the silver off him and fights at less than his full strength.
The Silver Hoard: the party beat the Gilded Knight (encounter gilded_knight) and the tithe chest is theirs to open.
The Silver Hoard: the party took the tithe-keeper's golden idol from his armour.
